event.title: DHS Justifies ICE Shooting in NYC Amid Protests and Mayor's Condemnation
event.canonical_title: DHS Justifies ICE Shooting in NYC Amid Protests and Mayor's Condemnation
event.summary: The Department of Homeland Security defended the actions of ICE agents who shot a 28-year-old man in New York City, stating that the officers believed they were in danger. The incident has sparked protests, with Mayor Zohran Mamdani condemning the shooting and accusing agents of terrorizing the city.

timeline.title: New York City Police Use-of-Force Review Ordered by Mayor Mamdani
timeline.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani has ordered a review of the New York Police Department's use-of-force policies, marking the first such review in a decade. This decision comes amid calls for greater police reform, although city officials state that it is not directly related to a recent police response to an ICE shooting. The review aims to address concerns raised by progressive advocates regarding police practices.
key_facts: Mayor Zohran Mamdani has ordered a review of NYPD's use-of-force policies.
This is the first review of its kind in ten years.
City officials assert the review is not linked to a recent ICE shooting incident.
